name: save_macro
description: Saves a new immutable macro version. This requires macro-author privileges.

node.description: Registered node identifier; URLs are not accepted.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot returned by observation. Required for cached element or chapter references.

request_id.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 operation identifier. Generated by the gateway when omitted; never automatically retry a mutation.

postcondition.description: Expected result, checked after dispatch; without it success only means dispatched. Name something that is false before the action, such as the row that appears once data has loaded, not a loading indicator or a control that already exists. The node waits up to timeout_ms (default 30000) and returns as soon as it holds, or at once with unexpected_dialog when the program opens a dialog instead. On postcondition_failed check again with verify_element; never repeat the action.

decision.description: Agent decision recorded before dispatch; required for semantic interaction with a detected modal dialog when local dialog interaction is enabled, and for every action on a control whose guard rule requires a decision. No secrets or message bodies. The node classifies the dialog itself; a refusal naming decider person or blocked means hand control back, never retry.

next_steps.description: What the agent plans to do after this step, in plain words. The person at the machine sees it while the agent is paused or in slow motion. A refusal with code paused_by_person did nothing: observe again before the next step and never rerun a macro from its first step.
